title: Open disclosure triggers before the sweep snapshots a route
notes: date-locale never saw the ISO dates on InteliFactu's fiscal review: they sit in tray rows that mount only after a tray counter is clicked. Routes can already list click selectors; the gap is discovering such triggers without configuration. Smallest next step: decide how a trigger is recognised (aria-expanded=false, aria-controls) and capture one extra state per trigger, bounded.
